abilities.name: Shield Bash
abilities.description: A 3-wide wall of force, two tiles deep — the whole face of the shield. Melee — ignores cover.

abilities.name: Barrier Pulse
abilities.description: Allies in the aimed area gain a 20-point shield for the turn. Aim it at yourself or the teammate about to be dived.

abilities.name: Intercept
abilities.description: Teleport beside an ally within 5 and take their hits. For the rest of the turn, damage aimed at that ally is dealt to Aegis instead — and Aegis alone gains an 18 shield, most but not all of one regular attack. Resolves in Dash, before Blast: he arrives, and then the blow lands on him. Alone, it is just the teleport and the shield.

abilities.name: Warding Wall
abilities.description: Raise a four-tile barrier of force: pick a square within 4, then turn it to face any of the four directions. It stands for this turn only: any enemy who walks, charges or is shoved through it takes 25 and is Weakened next turn. A blink goes around it.

ultimate.name: Warding Halo
ultimate.description: A halo of force centered on Aegis: allies within 2 squares gain a 40-point shield for 2 turns; enemies within it are Weakened. Stand between your carry and their team. (100 energy)
